entities.summary: Alexander Davidovich Goldfarb is a Russian-American microbiologist, activist, and author. He emigrated from the USSR in 1975 and studied in Israel and Germany before settling permanently in New York in 1982. Goldfarb is a naturalized American citizen. He has combined a scientific career as a microbiologist with political and public activities focused on civil liberties and human rights in Russia, in the course of which he has been associated with Andrei Sakharov, George Soros, Boris Berezovsky, and Alexander Litvinenko. He has not visited Russia since 2000. Alexander Goldfarb was a performers & entertainers from Moscow (b. 1947-05-23, Moscow). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a key associate of Andrei Sakharov and George Soros, Alexander Goldfarb played a significant role in promoting human rights and civil liberties in Russia, particularly during the late Soviet era. His involvement helped shape the post-Soviet political landscape.
